newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt shares slip, popular stocks buoy volume.
newsitem.headline: Egypt shares slip, popular stocks buoy volume.

text.p: Egyptian share prices slipped on Wednesday but popular cement shares buoyed volume, brokers said.
The Capital Market Authority (CMA) overall index fell 0.50 points to 233.90 while volume was an above-average 31.67 million pounds ($9.31 million).
"Prices are going up and the volume is high. There's new money coming onto the market, which continues to grow," said broker Mohamed Magdi of Hermes/EFG.

Cement giants continued their recent domination of the market, with Suez Cement leading the way after shares worth more than 4.50 million pounds traded. The stock ended the day 2.00 pounds higher at 52.00.
Helwan Portland Cement also did well, finishing 0.10 pounds higher at 50.00 after shares worth two million pounds exchanged hands.
Egyptian Starch and Glucose was another strong contender with trade in shares worth more than two million pounds. The stock ended the day 1.40 pounds higher at 41.25.
"It's the turn of Egyptian Starch and Glucose. Everything has had an increase. It's a very good stock and it's about time. I think it will continue to rise," Magdi said.
The CMA index for openly traded firms rose to 356.29 points from Tuesday's 351.73 and the index for rarely traded "closed" firms fell to 159.94 points from 160.29.
